title: Tencent launches HY4 Preview AI coding model with 770B params and 1M #Tencent #HY4Preview #AICoding
description: Tencent released HY4 Preview, a free open-source AI model designed for coding, tool use, and AI agents. With 770 billion parameters and a context window of one million tokens, it can handle entire codebases and long technical documents without losing context. The model reportedly outperforms GPT 5.6 on multiple benchmarks, enabling developers to run it on their own infrastructure, inspect its workings, and fine-tune it for specialized tasks. HY4 Preview offers significant potential for building advanced AI coding tools and agent systems without subscription costs. Its open-source nature promotes transparency and customization, marking a noteworthy shift in AI model accessibility and competition within the software development market. #TencentHY4 #HY4Preview #OpenSourceAI #AICodingModel #AIProgramming #AIagents #LargeLanguageModels #GPTBenchmark #TechInnovation #AItools #CodeAI #AIresearch #MachineLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #SoftwareDevelopment
